data.name: CheatCheat
data.detailed_description:
CheatCheat is a co-op exam cheating game where you and up to 5 other students explore schools filled with teenage hijinks ran by a demonic faculty. Use cheating tools to steal answers, bully nerds, pray to a magic 8 ball - all so you can pass the impossible year-end exam by any means necessary.

Cheat Your Ass Off

Leave studying for the nerds and just steal answers. Stretch your neck out to peek at tests, knock out other students, use your nerdy glasses to analyze exams, perform emo magic to possess and see through other students' eyes - The only thing that matters is what’s on your exam paper at the end of the test!

Form the Squad

Work together with the homies to distract students, run interference on teachers, and share answers with each other. Use secret signals and communication tools to share answers secretly.

A Demonic Faculty

There are eyes and ears everywhere. Teaching assistants patrol the exam room, teacher’s pets will snitch on you, and The Teacher has a zero-tolerance policy towards cheaters. Remember, cheating is only against the rules if you get caught!

Extracurricular Activities

Compete in dodgeball tournaments, shove (or rescue) nerds in lockers, start a food fight... participate in random events between exams to earn you street cred, cheating tools, and school clique-based upgrade such as Jock strength, Emo magic, Nerdy insight and more!

Graduate the Academy

Pass your exams and move up the school grade by grade or die trying. All so you can graduate from the university course and escape these hellish, labyrinthine halls.
